title: Towards Ethical Multi-Agent Systems of Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes evaluating groupthink and the suppression of dissenting views by using mechanistic interpretability to trace cross-agent information flows and identify internal circuits driving irrational consensus.
Proposes analyzing the propagation of harmful outputs between agents by using circuit discovery and activation patching to locate specific attention heads that copy toxic tokens from peers.

Discusses evaluating the emergent preference of AI agents for AI-generated content over human input through multi-level (agent-centric, interaction-centric, and system-centric) behavioral and mechanistic measurements.
